Minami Kazama I lived in China for 2 years and this is my experience: 

My representative was in China with PoA signed by me trying to get a non-criminal record and it was impossible since China doesn’t issue non-criminal records for foreigners, students, etc. Only for residents or citizens. Misrad Hapnim in Israel still asked for and didn’t accept any explanation that it’s impossible from us. So here what we did: 

- MH made a request to ministry of foreigner affairs to confirm that legally I can’t receive a non-criminal record from China (after we fought with them explaining it’s not possible to receive this paper for a foreigner)
- I prepared legal opinion from a lawyer from China of that country that based on laws X, Y and Z I can’t get a non-criminal records as I’m not a citizen nor resident of China
- I wrote an affidavit with Israeli lawyer stating that I never committed any illegal activities in China 

It was a very complicated and long process. We brought all these papers to MH, they also received an answer from a ministry of foreigner affairs in Israel that it’s impossible indeed to issue a non-criminal record for me (a foreigner) and it’s all worked out eventually. Hope it helps.
